transcript.text: If your tumble dryer is truly running continuously and will not shut down, this usually points to either a control fault (the switch telling the motor to stop isn't working) or a stuck relay on the main circuit board. Before we look at repairs, please try turning the dial firmly to 'Off' or pressing the Stop/Pause button. Does it stop immediately, or does it keep running even after you've switched it off?
it does stop if i open the door. its just after it says End it keeps turning every few mins

That behaviour—running for a few minutes then stopping—is often normal. Many dryers run the drum occasionally at the end of a cycle to prevent creases from setting in, especially if you haven't removed the clothes immediately. However, since it only stops when you open the door (which cuts power), we need to rule out an electronic fault where the board thinks the cycle isn't finished yet. If so, that's likely child lock or a delay start feature keeping it active.
ok, what should I do? i dont think i set a delay or child lock

Since it stops when you open the door but runs intermittently after 'End', this is very likely a normal crease-free tumble feature designed to keep clothes fresh if you can't take them out immediately. Please check your control panel for a small key or padlock symbol that might be lit up; if you see one, hold the corresponding button (often marked with the lock icon) for 3–5 seconds to turn it off. Is there any such light on, and did turning it off change anything?
no lock light on that i can see. its still doing it, just turns for a bit every few mins after End

This is probably the normal 'crease-free' or 'anti-crease' feature. It runs the drum for a few minutes every 30–60 minutes after the cycle ends to stop clothes from setting in wrinkles if you can't unload them immediately. This is standard on most modern dryers and cannot be permanently disabled without specialist service, but it does not affect performance or safety. You can simply open the door to pause it when you are ready to take the laundry out.
